summary: Completed comprehensive Phase 1 MVP testing for KONNTO AI. Backend APIs fully functional with 100% pass rate (24/24 tests). Frontend pages load correctly with proper navigation. Demo seed working as expected with sample org, 4 members, 8 work items, 1 approval, 1 thread, 3 knowledge facts, and morning brief.
passed_tests: ✅ Backend: Root endpoint (GET /api/)
✅ Backend: Onboarding + Demo Seed (POST /api/onboarding) - Creates org with 4 members, 8 items, 1 approval, 1 thread, 3 facts
✅ Backend: GET /api/me - Returns user, org, member, needs_onboarding, pending_approvals, whatsapp_connected
✅ Backend: GET /api/dashboard - Returns counts (overdue=1, due_today=1, stuck=1, done_week=1, approvals=1, team=4), brief present
✅ Backend: GET /api/items with filters (all, overdue, due, stuck, done) - All working correctly
✅ Backend: POST /api/chat/stream - SSE streaming works (user -> cards -> delta* -> done), done event contains final message
✅ Backend: POST /api/chat/cards/{card_id}/save - Creates work item from proposal card
✅ Backend: POST /api/chat/cards/{card_id}/undo - Reverts saved card (soft-delete)
✅ Backend: POST /api/chat/cards/{card_id}/skip - Marks card as skipped
✅ Backend: GET /api/members - Returns 4 seeded members (owner + Priya + Ramesh + Gupta)
✅ Backend: POST /api/members - Creates invited member with invite_token, invite_code, invite_url, share_url
✅ Backend: DELETE /api/members/{id} - Soft-removes member
✅ Backend: GET /api/threads - Returns seeded direct thread with Priya
✅ Backend: GET /api/threads/{id}/messages - Returns 3 seeded messages + people + thread objects
✅ Backend: POST /api/threads/{id}/messages - Posts new message, updates last_message_at
✅ Backend: GET /api/approvals?status=pending - Returns 1 seeded approval (drill)
✅ Backend: POST /api/approvals/{id}/decide - Marks approval as allowed_once
✅ Backend: POST /api/approvals/{id}/undo - Reverses decision back to pending
✅ Backend: GET /api/knowledge - Returns business + 3 facts + 0 rules + documents count + people count
✅ Backend: POST /api/knowledge - Creates fact
✅ Backend: DELETE /api/knowledge/{id} - Soft-removes fact (sets deleted:True)
✅ Backend: GET /api/rules - Returns rules list
✅ Backend: GET /api/privacy/summary - Returns member data counts
✅ Backend: GET /api/privacy/export - Returns JSON export
✅ Frontend: Landing page loads at / with hero text 'Talk to KONNTO', no console errors
✅ Frontend: Clerk sign-in redirects to /onboarding for new users
✅ Frontend: Onboarding page loads with WhatsApp input, consent checkbox, Continue button
✅ Frontend: All app pages load: /app/chat, /app/dashboard, /app/work, /app/team, /app/approvals, /app/documents, /app/knowledge, /app/settings, /app/privacy, /app/help
✅ Frontend: Mobile viewport (390x844) - No horizontal overflow detected
✅ Demo Seed: Idempotent - Only seeds if org has no items
✅ Demo Seed: Creates 3 sample people (Priya Nair, Ramesh Kumar, Gupta Cement)
✅ Demo Seed: Creates 8 work items in varied states (1 overdue, 1 due today, 1 stuck, 1 done, 4 others)
✅ Demo Seed: Creates 1 pending approval from Ramesh (Buy replacement drill, ₹8,500)
✅ Demo Seed: Creates project 'This week'
✅ Demo Seed: Creates direct thread with Priya with 3 sample messages
✅ Demo Seed: Creates 3 knowledge facts
✅ Demo Seed: Creates morning brief in brain_messages
